column1: # header-value "-" means no X-Gateway-Model-Name header is sent.
#   svc-c     model name "model-c", model-based routing DISABLED
#   neighbour plain HTTPRoute on the same gateway: PathPrefix /docs and PathPrefix /
# Nothing here asserts an expectation. The harness records what actually
# happens and diffs it against golden/. Probes marked ">> " in a trailing
# comment are the ones a shape change is expected to move.
# PathPrefix is segment-based: these ride the prefix rule, not the catch-all
# stateful sub-resources -- already pool-addressable here, since the path family
# has always used PathPrefix. The header family's twins are what differ.
# ...but a partial segment must NOT match the prefix rule
# not in the endpoint list -> workload Service via the catch-all
# a name that merely starts with an existing service name
# adapters get no publisher path of their own
# v1-model-routing uses Exact paths; v1-catch-all-model-routing has no path.
# Exact, so sub-paths fall through -- asymmetric with the name-path family.
# These are exactly what a switch from Exact to PathPrefix would broaden into,
# so each one is a line item in that decision rather than an argument about it.
# stateful Responses sub-resources: no body, so no producer can set the header.
# Reaching the pool at all means a client set it by hand -- and the EPP answers
# 400 "model not found in request body" (director.go:246, no bodyless guard).
# Anthropic Message Batches: POST nests model per-request, GET carries none
# arbitrary depth under a pool endpoint -- nothing in the API spec lives here,
# but PathPrefix would accept it and Exact does not
# segment boundary must hold for PathPrefix too: this is NOT under /v1/completions
# >> these reach the workload Service today; the header-only collapse moves them to the pool
# no header at all -> no header rule can match
# bare (unqualified) adapter name -- vLLM serves it, the route does not match it
# a name nested under the base -- pins that today's flat scheme does not match it
# >> neighbour route at a longer prefix should win on path precedence
# >> neighbour route at "/" ties on path, loses on header count
# nested-naming anchoring (H3). svc-ai's qualified name extends svc-a's, so a
# regex like publishers/ns/models/model-a(/.*)? must not capture it. Recorded
# under every shape so the before/after is visible when nested lands.
